segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so I sent over the revised quote this morning for 42 user seats and the two plant locations, Tulsa and Dayton. Annual subscription is $18,900, onboarding is $3,200 one time, and the term starts September 1.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, I saw it. The seat count is right. My main question is invoice timing. We need the invoice dated after September 1, not in August, or AP will kick it back.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, that's fine. The order form says billing on contract start, net 30, so the invoice would generate September 1 with payment due October 1.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. And for go-live, we're still targeting September 16? We have the audit prep starting the week after, so I don't want to slide much.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: September 16 is still the date. The onboarding plan has the equipment import on September 4, admin training on September 9, and end-user training on September 12. Your calibration history file is listed as the one export from your maintenance system.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Right, it's about 6,800 assets. Some of the pressure gauges have duplicate tag numbers, but our quality manager is cleaning those up this week.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. If you send the file by August 30, our team can flag any duplicates during import and send you the exception list the same day.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: On contract terms, procurement asked if the auto-renewal is required. They prefer a 60-day written notice window instead of 90.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: We can do 60 days. I updated that in the order form already, and it's reflected in section 5. No change to price or start date.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Alright. If I sign today, can you add me and Priya as billing contacts? Priya needs the PO number on the invoice, PO-44718.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. I'll add both billing contacts and the PO number before it goes out. Once you sign, you'll get a countersigned copy, and the kickoff invite will come over for September 4.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. I'll route it for signature now. You should have it back by end of day.
